text:
I’m a passionate, hard-working freelancer with 6 years of experience in Python, machine learning, and NLP, and I’d be glad to help you build a simple, polished website for latexandlovers.de.

Your project is straightforward, and I can approach it with a focus on clean structure, clear navigation, and a user-friendly presentation that matches the theme of latexandlovers.co.uk. I’m comfortable working with content-heavy pages, basic SEO best practices, and integrating external links in a way that feels natural to visitors. For the German content, I can use AI translation tools carefully and then review the text for clarity and consistency so the site reads well.

Although most of my work has been in data and automation rather than web design, I’ve built practical user-facing tools and workflows that required organized implementation and attention to the end user. For example, at Cobalt Coffee Roasters I built a small Streamlit app that grouped 38k marketplace reviews into themes and tracked sentiment per theme each week, which produced 12 stable themes and replaced about 2 days a month of manual tagging. At Marrow & Pine Grocers, I built weekly store-by-SKU forecasts for 420 SKUs across 31 stores, scheduled in Airflow and written back to BigQuery, which reduced WAPE from 31% to 19% and lowered spoilage write-offs by 11% in the pilot stores.

That background means I’m used to turning requirements into something dependable, practical, and easy to use. I would keep the website simple, mobile-friendly, and focused on the affiliate goals: eBay links, Amazon links, and a clear cross-link to your existing website. I can also make sure the page structure supports basic SEO so the site has a better chance of being found.

If helpful, I can start by outlining a simple page structure and content plan for the German version—would you like the site to be just a single landing page, or do you want a few separate pages as well?
